name: memkit
description: Injects pointers to your own memory files into every prompt: lexical retrieval over a tiered markdown store, plus a checker and an eval for it.

memkitConfig.title: memkit config file
memkitConfig.description: Absolute path to the JSON config naming your memory stores. /memkit:init writes this file for you at the path you give here, and the plugin is inert until it exists: no directory of yours is read before then. Set it at install — an install that skips it has no route to a config and stays silent with nothing at runtime to say so.

memkitInterpreter.title: python that runs the recall hook
memkitInterpreter.description: Absolute path to the python the hook runs under. Leave it unset unless memkit asks for it: the wrapper resolves one itself and /memkit:init records the one it ran under. Set it when the wrapper reports that nothing it tried can run the hook — a python below 3.9, or one whose sqlite3 has no FTS5, which is the table the index is. The path is probed before it is used and skipped with a reason if it fails, so a wrong value cannot make this install worse than an unset one.
